title: feat(polli-cli): add 3D, embeddings, and voice tools to polli gen
author: tomdacatto
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #15526

Outcome checklist:
- `polli gen 3d "a red fox"` / `polli gen 3d --image <url> --resolution high` → saves the file with the extension inferred from the response's `Content-Type` (`model/gltf-binary` → `.glb`, `model/ply` → `.ply` for `nvidia/asset-harvester`), not guessed from the model name. `--model`, `--resolution`, `--seed`, `--output`, repeatable `--image` all supported. `--model` defaults to `hyper3d/rodin-2.5` for a text-only prompt and `microsoft/trellis-2` once `--image` is given — `trellis-2` is image-to-3D only and rejects a bare prompt server-side.
- `polli gen embeddings "a" "b"` → one JSON array per line, in input order (server responses aren't guaranteed ordered — sorted by `index` before printing). Reads stdin (one input per line, `\r?\n`-split) when no arguments are given. `--model`, `--dimensions`, `--task-type` (Gemini), `--input-type` (Cohere). `--json` prints the full response including `usage`.
- `polli gen voice-change talk.mp3 --voice nova` → re-speaks a local file in another voice; `--format` picks the output format and default filename.
- `polli gen isolate interview.mp4` → strips music/background noise from local audio or video, default `isolated.mp3`.
- `polli gen audio "Hello" --timestamps` → saves the audio as usual and writes character-level timing JSON next to it (appending `.json` to the complete output path, so the files cannot collide).
- `polli models --type 3d` (and `--type all`) now include the 3 registered 3D models.
- Same conventions as existing `gen` commands throughout: dynamic `--output` defaults, `--json` mirrors human fields, errors surface the API's own message.

## Two real bugs found along the way

1. `voice-change` and `isolate` upload the local file as a multipart `Blob`. gist.headline: Polli grows a few new tricks
gist.blurb: The CLI can now make 3D models, turn text into embeddings, change a recording’s voice, and clear background noise. It also gives generated speech its own character-level timing notes.
gist.summary: Added `polli gen 3d` with prompt-to-3D via `hyper3d/rodin-2.5` and image-to-3D via `microsoft/trellis-2`, plus ordered embeddings output, voice changing, audio isolation, and character-level timestamps for generated speech.
gist.impact: CLI users can save 3D files with extensions determined by their response type, stream embeddings in input order, re-voice or isolate local recordings, and get timing JSON alongside generated audio.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy terminal garden shows the CLI's new tools as a small pixel fox sculpture, neatly ordered embedding cards, and a waveform being cleaned up beside a microphone. Polli wears tiny headphones and tends the tools like code-plants; a friendly CRT monitor robot displays the commands.
